summary: Iteration 36: Frontend-only test of AgencyFB font application + Footer social icons admin integration. ALL 36 checks PASSED. Verified getComputedStyle().fontFamily starts with 'Agency FB' on 18 individual data-testid targets + 4 stat labels + 2 category CTAs (24 elements total). Verified enlarged sizes (OCTUBRE/DICIEMBRE 20px, finales-subtitle 30px, finales-cta 20px, region-subtitle/Comfenalco Soleden 36px, cat-festival/premier-cta 18px with 10px 28px padding). Footer phone shows '+57 312 360 5948' as-is (no lowercase transform, '+' visible). Footer email shows 'direccion@futuresoccercup.org' with '@' visible. Plane Crash regression intact on hero-edition, hero-year, region-title, footer-heading. Admin /admin/home → set Instagram/Facebook/YouTube URLs → all 3 icons render on Home (incl. red YouTube SVG). Conditional rendering: clearing IG removed [data-testid=footer-instagram] from DOM while FB+YT remained. Restored all 3 URLs so icons persist for user verification.

critical_code_review_comments: Note (not a bug): AgencyFB is commercial; no TTF shipped. Browser uses fallback (likely Arial Narrow / system condensed). Visual rendering is acceptable condensed sans-serif, but if main agent wants exact AgencyFB look, ship the .woff2 under /public/fonts and add @font-face declaration in index.css.
Pre-existing (iter35 noted): GET /api/auth/me returns 401 on public pages → 2 console errors. Cosmetic.
Phone number stored in DB is '+57 312 360 5948', not the '+57 324 6134658' mentioned in problem statement. Admin can update via /admin/home → Footer/Contacto → Teléfono if desired; not a code bug.
